name: Can I remain living in my house during a major interior construction project?

mainEntity.name: Can I remain living in my house during a major interior construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Living on-site during construction offers convenience and avoids temporary relocation expenses, but it requires managing dust, construction noise, and temporary disruptions to utilities or room access. Staying in the home is usually practical during localized basement remodels or single-room updates when crews can isolate the workspace with plastic barriers. However, whole-home renovations or comprehensive main-floor reconfigurations may produce significant disruption, making temporary alternate arrangements more comfortable. Clear communication regarding daily work hours and clean-up routines helps keep living conditions manageable if you stay on-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, for localized projects like basement or bathroom remodels, though you must prepare for daily noise, dust containment barriers, and temporary disruptions to utilities.
